item.title: GenLARP: Enabling Immersive Live Action Role Play through LLM-Generated Worlds and Characters
item.description: ISMAR 2025 Poster: GenLARP leverages large language models to generate interactive worlds and AI-driven characters, enabling immersive live action role play (LARP) for collaborative learning and narrative exploration.
